slides.say: The Profiler component measures how long a part of your tree takes to render.
Wrap a tree with Profiler, give it an id, and an on render callback.
React calls on render every time that tree commits. Compare actual duration with base duration, the cost without memoization, to see if memo is working.

slides.text: Adds overhead, so it’s off in production builds by default.
slides.say: Profiling adds overhead, so it is disabled in production builds by default.
